content: Machine learning methods are well-known to pick up on spurious statistical patterns. For instance, in image captioning, a simple baseline of utilizing the captions of nearest neighbors in the training set was shown to yield impressive BLEU scores BIBREF35. In the first visual question answering dataset BIBREF36, biases like “2” being the correct answer to 39% of the questions starting with “how many” allowed learning algorithms to perform well while ignoring the visual modality altogether BIBREF37, BIBREF38. The field has a tendency to overfit on static targets, even if that does not happen deliberately BIBREF39.
